qs.stem: The distance of the point (3, 3, -2) from the plane 1x + 2y + 2z − 2 = 0 is
steps: Distance = |ax<sub>1</sub> + by<sub>1</sub> + cz<sub>1</sub> + d|/√(a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup>).
qs.trap: Forgetting the square-root denominator.

qs.stem: In the expansion of (x<sup>2</sup> + 1/x)<sup>6</sup>, the coefficient of x<sup>-3</sup> is
steps: Power of x: 2(6 − j) − j = -3, so j = 5.
qs.trap: Swapping the powers of the two constants.

qs.stem: The distance between the foci of the ellipse x<sup>2</sup>/225 + y<sup>2</sup>/81 = 1 is
steps: a<sup>2</sup> = 225, b<sup>2</sup> = 81 so c<sup>2</sup> = a<sup>2</sup> − b<sup>2</sup> = 144, c = 12.
qs.trap: Giving c instead of 2c.

qs.stem: If the sum of the first n terms of a sequence is S<sub>n</sub> = 2n<sup>2</sup> + 4n, the 8<sup>th</sup> term is
qs.trap: Taking T<sub>k</sub> = S<sub>k</sub>.

qs.stem: If α and β are the roots of x<sup>2</sup> − 14x + 45 = 0, then α<sup>2</sup> + β<sup>2</sup> is equal to
qs.trap: Using +2αβ instead of −2αβ.

qs.stem: The radius of the circle x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup> − 6x − 2y − 6 = 0 is
steps: Compare with x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup> + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0: g = −3, f = −1, c = -6.
qs.trap: Reporting r<sup>2</sup> instead of r.

qs.stem: If tan A = 1/4 and tan B = 1/3, then tan(A + B) is
steps: tan(A + B) = (tan A + tan B)/(1 − tan A tan B).
qs.trap: Using + in the denominator.

qs.stem: If P(A) = 1/4, P(B) = 7/24 and P(A ∩ B) = 5/24, then P(A ∪ B) is
steps: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B).
qs.trap: Forgetting to subtract the overlap.

qs.stem: The number of symmetric relations on a set with 3 elements is
steps: A symmetric relation is fixed by choosing among the 3 diagonal pairs and the 3 unordered off-diagonal pairs.
qs.trap: Ignoring the diagonal pairs.

qs.stem: If dy/dx = 4y with y(0) = 5, then y(ln 2 / 4) equals
steps: At x = ln 2/4: e<sup>ln 2</sup> = 2, so y = 5 × 2 = 10.
qs.trap: Evaluating e<sup>kx</sup> as x instead of e<sup>ln m</sup> = m.

qs.stem: If A is a 2 × 2 matrix with det A = 3, then det(4A) equals
steps: det(kA) = k<sup>n</sup> det A for an n × n matrix.
qs.trap: Multiplying det A by k only once.

qs.stem: lim<sub>x→0</sub> sin(5x)/(9x) equals
qs.trap: Inverting the ratio.

qs.stem: For z<sub>1</sub> = 4 + 3i and z<sub>2</sub> = 3 + 3i, the value of |z<sub>1</sub>z<sub>2</sub>|<sup>2</sup> is
qs.trap: Adding the squared moduli instead of multiplying.

qs.stem: For a binomial distribution the mean is 12 and the variance is 3. The number of trials n is
steps: Mean = np and variance = npq, so q = variance/mean = 1/4 and p = 3/4.
qs.trap: Taking n = mean or n = mean + variance.

qs.stem: The sum of the first 15 terms of the arithmetic progression 6, 11, 16, … is
qs.trap: Using nd instead of (n − 1)d.

qs.stem: The maximum value of f(x) = −x<sup>2</sup> + 2x + 2 is
steps: The maximum occurs at x = 1 and equals 3.
qs.trap: Reading the constant term 2 as the maximum.

qs.stem: If A = [[1, 4], [0, 1]], the sum of all the entries of A<sup>4</sup> is
steps: A<sup>4</sup> = [[1, 16], [0, 1]], whose entries add up to 2 + 16 = 18.
qs.trap: Computing A<sup>p</sup> as entrywise powers.

qs.stem: The value of the integral ∫<sub>0</sub><sup>6</sup> (x<sup>2</sup> + 3x) dx is
qs.trap: Dropping the 1/3 or 1/2 factor.

qs.stem: The number of distinct arrangements of all the letters of the word ALLAHABAD is
steps: The word has 9 letters. Repeated letters: A×4 L×2.
qs.trap: Not dividing by the factorial of each repeated letter.

qs.stem: The number of solutions of sin 3x = 0 in the interval [0, 2π] is
steps: Write the general solution and count the values of x that fall in [0, 2π], including both end points.
qs.trap: Missing an end point of the closed interval.

qs.stem: The distance of the point (1, 0) from the line 6x + 8y + 34 = 0 is
qs.trap: Forgetting to divide by √(a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup>).

qs.stem: lim<sub>x→3</sub> (x<sup>4</sup> − 81)/(x − 3) equals
steps: The limit is the derivative of x<sup>4</sup> at x = 3.
qs.trap: Writing a<sup>m</sup> instead of a<sup>m−1</sup>.

qs.stem: The sum of the first 5 terms of the geometric progression 5, 15, 45, … is
qs.trap: Using r<sup>n+1</sup> instead of r<sup>n</sup>.

qs.stem: The determinant of the matrix with rows [1 −2 4]   [3 −2 1]   [2 2 3] is
steps: Expand along the first row: a(ei − fh) − b(di − fg) + c(dh − eg).
qs.trap: Sign slip on the middle term of the expansion.

qs.stem: A committee of 4 is chosen from 4 men and 5 women. The number of committees containing at least one woman is
qs.trap: Counting a committee with two women twice (choose one woman, then anyone).

qs.stem: Two capacitors of 6 μF and 12 μF are connected in series. The equivalent capacitance is (in μF)
qs.trap: Mixing up the series and parallel formulas.

qs.stem: A Carnot engine works between a source at 900 K and a sink at 300 K. Its efficiency (in %) is
qs.trap: Using T<sub>2</sub>/T<sub>1</sub> as the efficiency.

qs.stem: Light of wavelength 310 nm falls on a metal of work function 1.5 eV (hc = 1240 eV nm). The maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectrons is (in eV)
qs.trap: Giving the photon energy instead of the kinetic energy.

qs.stem: A spring of force constant 300 N/m is compressed by 0.2 m. The energy stored in it is (in J)
qs.trap: Forgetting the ½, or not squaring x.

qs.stem: In measuring kinetic energy K = ½mv<sup>2</sup>, the mass has a 3% error and the speed a 4% error. The maximum percentage error in K is
qs.trap: Not doubling the speed error for v<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: A fixed mass of ideal gas goes from (P = 1 atm, V = 4 L, T = 300 K) to a state with P = 2 atm and V = 3 L. The final temperature is (in K)
qs.trap: Inverting the ratio.

qs.stem: A heater of resistance 50 Ω is connected to a 100 V supply for 30 s. The heat produced is (in J)
qs.trap: Using I = V/R as the power.

qs.stem: A body weighs 160 N on the surface of the earth (radius R). Its weight at a height of R above the surface is (in N)
steps: g′ = g R<sup>2</sup>/(R + h)<sup>2</sup> = g/(1 + h/R)<sup>2</sup> = g/4.
qs.trap: Dividing by (R + h) instead of (R + h)<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: A 4 kg mass attached to a spring of constant 1600 N/m oscillates with amplitude 3 cm. Its maximum speed is (in cm/s)
qs.trap: Using ω<sup>2</sup> instead of ω.

qs.stem: An object is placed 24 cm in front of a convex lens of focal length 8 cm. The image is formed at a distance (in cm) of
qs.trap: Using u as a positive number in the lens formula.

qs.stem: A closed organ pipe resonates at its fundamental in a wave of wavelength 2 m. The length of the pipe is (in m)
steps: A closed pipe holds a quarter wavelength in its fundamental.
qs.trap: Using λ/2 (that is for an open pipe).

qs.stem: A rotating platform has moment of inertia 6 kg m<sup>2</sup> and angular speed 20 rad/s. A person on it changes the moment of inertia to 10 kg m<sup>2</sup> without any external torque. The new angular speed is (in rad/s)
steps: Angular momentum is conserved: I<sub>1</sub>ω<sub>1</sub> = I<sub>2</sub>ω<sub>2</sub>.
qs.trap: Inverting the ratio of the moments of inertia.

qs.stem: A body is projected with speed 50 m/s at an angle whose sine is 0.8. Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, the maximum height reached is (in m)
qs.trap: Using the full speed instead of the vertical component.

qs.stem: An object is placed 30 cm in front of a convex lens of focal length 20 cm. The image is formed at a distance (in cm) of
qs.trap: Using u as a positive number in the lens formula.

qs.stem: Two masses 7 kg and 5 kg hang from a light string over a smooth pulley (Atwood machine). Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, the tension in the string is (in N)
qs.trap: Taking the tension equal to the weight of the heavier mass.

qs.stem: A radioactive sample has half-life 20 days and initially 240 nuclei (in thousands). The number remaining after 60 days is (in thousands)
qs.trap: Dividing by the number of half-lives rather than by 2 raised to it.

qs.stem: Two trains of lengths 120 m and 80 m move towards each other on parallel tracks at 15 m/s and 25 m/s. They take how many seconds to cross each other completely?
qs.trap: Using the difference of speeds (that is for the same direction).

qs.stem: In Young's double-slit experiment the slit separation is 0.3 mm, the screen is 1.5 m away and the wavelength is 600 nm. The fringe width is (in mm)
qs.trap: Unit slip between nm, mm and m.

qs.stem: The dimensional formula of (velocity ÷ area) is
qs.trap: Adding exponents when dividing.

qs.stem: A system absorbs 850 J of heat and does 410 J of work on its surroundings. The change in its internal energy is (in J)
qs.trap: Adding work done by the system to the heat absorbed.

qs.stem: An ideal transformer has 500 turns in the primary and 50 turns in the secondary. With a primary voltage of 220 V the secondary voltage is (in V)
qs.trap: Inverting the turns ratio.

qs.stem: Resistors of 20 Ω and 5 Ω in parallel are connected in series with a 6 Ω resistor across a 20 V battery of negligible resistance. The current drawn from the battery is (in A)
qs.trap: Adding all three resistances in series.

qs.stem: A fixed mass of ideal gas goes from (P = 3 atm, V = 5 L, T = 100 K) to a state with P = 5 atm and V = 6 L. The final temperature is (in K)
qs.trap: Inverting the ratio.

qs.stem: A car moving at 40 m/s is brought to rest by a uniform retardation of 8 m/s<sup>2</sup>. The distance travelled before stopping is (in m)
qs.trap: Forgetting the factor 2 in 2as.

qs.stem: A wave of frequency 400 Hz has wavelength 0.85 m. Its speed is (in m/s)
qs.trap: Dividing instead of multiplying.

qs.stem: For a reaction ΔH = -40 kJ and ΔS = -100 J/K. The value of ΔG at 300 K is (in kJ)
qs.trap: Not converting J to kJ.

qs.stem: Among Li, F, O, Be, the element with the lowest first ionisation enthalpy is
steps: First ionisation enthalpies (kJ/mol): Li 520, F 1681, O 1314, Be 899.
The lowest value belongs to Li.
qs.trap: Forgetting the dips at Be/B and N/O.

qs.stem: The number of moles of H<sub>2</sub> needed to hydrogenate 1 mole of naphthalene (C<sub>10</sub>H<sub>8</sub>, complete hydrogenation) completely is
steps: Add 1 mol H<sub>2</sub> per C=C (or per ring in a saturated ring), 2 mol per C≡C, and 3 mol per benzene ring.
qs.trap: Counting a triple bond as taking one mole.

qs.stem: 10 mL of a 12 M solution is diluted until its molarity is 1.2 M. The final volume of the solution is (in mL)
qs.trap: Giving the volume of water added instead of the final volume.

qs.stem: According to molecular orbital theory, the bond order of N<sub>2</sub><sup>+</sup> is
steps: Fill the molecular orbitals in order and use bond order = (N<sub>b</sub> − N<sub>a</sub>)/2.
For N<sub>2</sub><sup>+</sup> the bond order is 2.5.
qs.trap: Using the electron count of the neutral molecule for an ion.

qs.stem: The pH of a 10<sup>−3</sup> M NaOH solution at 25°C is
qs.trap: Reporting pOH as the pH.

qs.stem: The number of peptide bonds in a linear polypeptide made from 5 amino acid residues is
steps: n residues joined in a chain have n − 1 peptide bonds.
qs.trap: Counting one bond per residue.

qs.stem: The mass of zinc (molar mass 65 g/mol, ion charge 2+) deposited by passing 48250 C of charge is (in g; F = 96500 C/mol)
qs.trap: Ignoring the charge on the ion.

qs.stem: The maximum number of orbitals in the shell with principal quantum number n = 5 is
steps: Each subshell l has 2l + 1 orbitals and l runs from 0 to n − 1.
qs.trap: Giving the number of electrons (2n<sup>2</sup>) instead.

qs.stem: The number of structural isomers (ignoring stereoisomers) of the compound C<sub>3</sub>H<sub>8</sub>O (alcohols and ethers) is
steps: Enumerate carbon skeletons, then place the functional group.
qs.trap: Missing a branched skeleton or counting stereoisomers.

qs.stem: The depression in freezing point of a 0.1 m aqueous solution of NaCl (assume complete dissociation) is (K<sub>f</sub> = 1.86 K kg/mol; in K)
steps: ΔT<sub>f</sub> = i K<sub>f</sub> m with van't Hoff factor i = 2.
qs.trap: Using i = 1 for an electrolyte.

qs.stem: A first-order reaction has 1000 g of reactant initially. After 3 half-lives the amount left is (in g)
steps: After each half-life the amount halves.
qs.trap: Dividing by the number of half-lives instead of 2 raised to it.

qs.stem: The number of different monochloro structural isomers obtainable from n-pentane by free-radical chlorination (ignore stereoisomers) is
steps: Count the sets of equivalent hydrogens: each set gives one monochloro product.
qs.trap: Counting every hydrogen as different.

qs.stem: The number of unpaired electrons in the complex [Cu(NH<sub>3</sub>)<sub>4</sub>]<sup>2+</sup> is
steps: The metal ion is Cu<sup>2+</sup>; use the ligand field strength to decide high-spin or low-spin filling.
qs.trap: Assuming high-spin for every complex.

qs.stem: The rate law of a substitution reaction is rate = k[RX][Nu<sup>−</sup>]. If the concentrations of both RX and Nu<sup>−</sup> are multiplied by 2, the rate changes by a factor of
steps: The rate depends only on the species present in the rate law, each to its own power.
qs.trap: Counting a species that is not in the rate law.

qs.stem: The number of bonds in all (σ and π together) in ethanoic acid (CH<sub>3</sub>COOH) is
steps: Every bond has one σ bond; each double bond adds one π bond and each triple bond adds two.
Counting for ethanoic acid (CH<sub>3</sub>COOH): σ = 7, π = 1.
qs.trap: Counting a triple bond as one π bond.

qs.stem: Liquids A and B form an ideal solution of 1 mol A and 3 mol B. Their vapour pressures when pure are 200 mm Hg and 500 mm Hg. The total vapour pressure of the solution is (in mm Hg)
qs.trap: Averaging the two pure vapour pressures without weighting by mole fraction.

qs.stem: Given A → B, ΔH = −20 kJ and B → C, ΔH = −25 kJ, the enthalpy change for 2A → 2C is (in kJ)
steps: Multiplying the equation by 2 multiplies ΔH: -90 kJ.
qs.trap: Not scaling ΔH by the stoichiometric factor.

qs.stem: For N<sub>2</sub> + 3H<sub>2</sub> ⇌ 2NH<sub>3</sub> the equilibrium concentrations are [N<sub>2</sub>] = 1 M, [H<sub>2</sub>] = 1 M and [NH<sub>3</sub>] = 4 M. The value of K<sub>c</sub> is
qs.trap: Writing the ratio upside-down or ignoring the stoichiometric powers.

qs.stem: For hydrogen-like species, the ratio of the radius of the n = 2 orbit to that of the n = 1 orbit (same species) is
qs.trap: Using r ∝ n instead of n<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: The steric number (bond pairs + lone pairs) of the central atom in XeF<sub>6</sub>, which has a distorted octahedral shape, is
steps: 6 bond pairs and 1 lone pairs on Xe.
qs.trap: Ignoring the lone pairs.

qs.stem: For a reaction A + B → products, doubling [A] alone raises the rate 4 times, and doubling [B] alone raises it 4 times. The overall order of the reaction is
steps: Rate ∝ [A]<sup>x</sup>[B]<sup>y</sup>: 2<sup>x</sup> = 4 gives x = 2 and 2<sup>y</sup> = 4 gives y = 2.
qs.trap: Adding the rate factors instead of the exponents.

qs.stem: The number of moles of O<sub>2</sub> required for complete combustion of 1 mole of the hydrocarbon C<sub>8</sub>H<sub>4</sub> is
qs.trap: Using y/2 instead of y/4.

qs.stem: The mass of CaCO<sub>3</sub> required to prepare 250 mL of a 2 M solution is (in g)
qs.trap: Using the volume in mL without converting to litres.

qs.stem: The degree of unsaturation (double-bond equivalents) of C<sub>10</sub>H<sub>8</sub> is
steps: DBE = (2C + 2 + N − H − X)/2 (oxygen does not count).
qs.trap: Counting oxygen or forgetting that N adds 1.
